[[File:Tower of Eldara.jpg|thumb|Tower of Eldara]]
The '''Tower of Eldara'''{{Coords|89|32|Azshara}} was once part of the extensive [[night elven]] civilization that stretched across most of what is now called [[Azshara]]. It is located on the very tip of land northeast of the [[Bay of Storms]], and the sandy beaches near the tower are heavily patrolled by [[murloc]]s, [[makrura]], and [[hydra]]s. The tower itself stands closed and abandoned.
